name: Huntington Bancshares Incorporated
tagline: Multi-state diversified regional bank holding company committed to making people's lives better
hero_kpi_rationale: Huntington a complété l'acquisition de Cadence Bank en février 2026, portant le réseau à près de 1 400 succursales dans 21 États, démontrant une stratégie d'expansion géographique significative et une consolidation majeure dans le secteur bancaire régional.

kpis.name_fr: Encours moyen de prets et credits-bails
kpis.signal: Volume de credit en forte hausse, dope par les acquisitions Veritex et Cadence.
Base de depots en forte croissance, gonflee par les partenariats Cadence et Veritex.
Marge en expansion continue, moteur de rentabilite du coeur bancaire.

kpis.name_fr: Taux de pertes nettes sur credits
kpis.signal: Cout du risque de credit tres bas et stable, signe d'une qualite d'actifs solide.
Premiere campagne de collecte de depots dans le reseau Cadence: production en hausse de 160% sur un an, preuve de traction post-integration
Sur les 2 premiers mois du digital active au Texas, production de depots dans l'empreinte Veritex en hausse de 30% sur un an
Integration systemes Veritex bouclee en seulement 187 jours apres l'annonce, un delai tres accelere qui securise les synergies de couts

kpis.short: New deposits from first Carolinas branches
kpis.signal: Les 7 premieres agences des Carolines ont capte $215M de nouveaux depots en moins d'un an, validant l'expansion geographique organique
Le conseil approuve une nouvelle autorisation de rachat d'actions de $3B (evergreen), remplacant le programme precedent et signalant une forte generation de capital
Integration de 1,5 million de nouveaux clients et 6 000 nouveaux collaborateurs via les partenariats Veritex et Cadence
Trimestre record pour les marches de capitaux avec un revenu organique en hausse de pres de 60% sur un an, hors acquisitions

kpis.name_fr: Couverture liquidite des depots non assures
kpis.signal: Liquidite contingente disponible couvrant 173% des depots non assures, l'un des niveaux les plus eleves du secteur
Exposition NDFI limitee a environ 2% du total des prets (hors REIT, subscription lines, assureurs bien notes), gerée en relation
Rachat de Cadence Bank valorise a 8.1 Md$ en actions, cloture le 1er fevrier 2026, qui apporte 54 Md$ d'actifs, 37 Md$ de prets et 44 Md$ de depots
Rachat de Veritex (Dallas) valorise a 1.7 Md$, cloture le 20 octobre 2025, ajoutant 12 Md$ d'actifs dont 9.3 Md$ de prets et 10.5 Md$ de depots

kpis.name_fr: Franchissement du seuil de 250 Md$ d'actifs
kpis.signal: Avec Cadence, les actifs consolides depassent 250 Md$ a la cloture, faisant passer Huntington en categorie III de supervision reglementaire
Le reseau passe de plus de 1000 agences dans 14 etats a pres de 1400 agences dans 21 etats apres la fusion Cadence

kpis.short: Common equity tier 1 risk-based capital ratio
kpis.signal: CET1 a 10.2% au T1-2026, en leger repli sequentiel apres l'acquisition Veritex mais toujours au-dessus du minimum reglementaire.
Provision en hausse a 158 M$ au T1-2026, refletant la croissance du portefeuille et la prudence sur le risque de credit.

kpis.short: Return on average tangible common shareholders' equity
kpis.signal: ROTCE a 11.6% au T1-2026, en retrait a cause des charges liees a l'integration Veritex apres des trimestres soutenus autour de 16-18%.
Coefficient d'exploitation degrade a 67.2% au T1-2026 sous l'effet des couts d'integration, contre un niveau de fond proche de 58-60%.
Pertes nettes a 111 M$ (0.26% des prets moyens) au T1-2026, en hausse mais a un niveau de risque de credit toujours contenu.

risks.title: Cybersecurity Risk
risks.score_rationale: As a major financial institution handling sensitive customer data and transaction systems, cybersecurity represents the highest risk category. Financial services are prime targets for sophisticated cyber attacks with potential for significant operational disruption and regulatory penalties.
risks.summary: Cybersecurity is a critical risk for the organization due to vulnerability of IT systems and sensitive customer data to increasingly sophisticated threats

risks.title: Credit Risk
risks.score_rationale: Credit risk is elevated due to exposure to potential loan losses, nonperforming assets, and economic downturn impacts. Large loan portfolio across multiple geographies and customer segments creates material exposure.
risks.summary: Credit risk is a major concern due to exposure to loan losses and nonperforming assets, particularly in stressed economic environments

risks.title: Regulatory Risk
risks.score_rationale: As a systemically important financial institution, Huntington faces extensive regulatory oversight with frequent regulatory changes affecting capital requirements, stress testing, and compliance obligations.
risks.summary: Regulatory risk is significant due to frequent changes in financial and banking regulations, capital requirements, and compliance obligations

risks.title: Liquidity Risk
risks.score_rationale: Moderate liquidity risk exists due to dependence on financial markets for funding and asset-liability management challenges, particularly in volatile rate environments.
risks.summary: Liquidity risk is a material concern due to dependence on financial markets for funding and potential deposit volatility

risks.title: Competition Risk
risks.score_rationale: Regional banking market faces intense competition from larger national banks, fintech companies, and community banks. Margin compression and customer acquisition challenges persist.
risks.summary: Competition risk is significant due to presence of numerous competitors in banking and financial services markets

risks.title: Reputation Risk
risks.score_rationale: As a public financial institution, reputational damage from operational failures, compliance breaches, or market downturns could affect customer confidence and capital markets access.
risks.summary: Reputation risk is important due to sensitivity of banking institution reputation to negative events and market perceptions

company_description: Huntington Bancshares Incorporated operates as the bank holding company for The Huntington National Bank that provides commercial, consumer, and mortgage banking services. It offers financial products and services to consumer and business customers, including deposits, lending, payments, mortgage banking, dealer financing, investment management, trust, brokerage, insurance, and other financial products and services. The company also provides 24-Hour Grace, Asterisk-Free Checking, Money Scout, $50 Safety Zone, Standby Cash, Early Pay, Instant Access, Savings Goal Getter, And Huntington Heads Up; digitally powered consumer and business financial solutions to consumer finance, regional banking, branch banking, and wealth management customers; direct and indirect consumer loans; dealer finance loans and deposits; and private banking, wealth management and legacy planning through investment and portfolio management, fiduciary administration and trust, institutional custody, and full-service retail brokerage investment services. In addition, it offers equipment financing, asset-based lending, distribution finance, structured lending, municipal financing solutions, and Huntington ChoicePa

customer_type.label: La société dessert à la fois les particuliers (B2C) et les entreprises (B2B), comme indiqué dans la description des services bancaires commerciaux et de consommation.
